intro: Wynberg is one of the older Southern Suburbs, a mix of Victorian cottages, flats and busy shopping streets around Maynardville and Main Road. We install and repair DSTV for homes, flats and small businesses across Wynberg.
context: With so much older housing, we often find worn cabling and dishes fitted years ago with no thought to alignment. Flats and shared buildings also need permission and a shared-roof plan. We start by checking what is there and what the building allows, then fit or fix it properly.

faq.q: Can you set up DSTV in a small business in Wynberg?
faq.a: Yes. We install in shops, offices and waiting rooms, with the right package and neat cabling so the screens stay reliable through the working day.

faq.q: My cottage has thick walls. Is that a problem?
faq.a: It affects how we run cable, not the signal at the dish. We route it through existing gaps where we can and avoid unnecessary drilling in old walls.

name: Sea Point
pageTitle: DSTV Installer Sea Point | Digitech DSTV
description: DSTV installation, repairs and signal fixing in Sea Point, for apartment blocks along the Atlantic promenade.
intro: Sea Point is one of Cape Town's most densely built-up areas, with tall apartment blocks facing the promenade and the Atlantic. We install and repair DSTV for owners, tenants and building managers across Sea Point.
context: Almost everyone here lives in a building with a body corporate, shared roofs and several floors between the dish and your TV, so the work involves permission, access and cable routes as much as the dish itself. Sea wind and salt are constant. We work through the building's rules, fix for exposed conditions, and keep to the agreed route.

faq.q: I rent a flat in Sea Point. Can I get DSTV?
faq.a: Often yes. Check whether your building already has a shared dish or an allowed position, and we can connect you or fit your own where it is permitted.

faq.q: Why does my picture break up in bad weather?
faq.a: Heavy rain can weaken a signal, and a dish that is slightly out of alignment suffers more. A proper alignment gives you the best margin in poor weather.

name: Parklands
description: DSTV installation, repairs and Extra View setup in Parklands, in the growing Blaauwberg area near Table View.
intro: Parklands is a large, fast-growing residential area in Blaauwberg, next to Table View, made up mostly of newer homes, townhouses and complexes. We install and repair DSTV across Parklands.
context: Many homes here are recent builds, often with no dish and cabling that was never run for a satellite system, or with a decoder that has only ever been connected in one room. We handle first-time installations, run cabling for extra rooms, and set up Extra View so the whole household is covered from the start.

faq.q: My new home has no DSTV wiring. Can you install from scratch?
faq.a: Yes. We fit the dish, run the cabling to your TV points and set up the decoder, and we can add more rooms with Extra View.

faq.q: I live in a complex in Parklands. Where does the dish go?
faq.a: That depends on the complex rules. We can work with the managing agent to place it where it is permitted and has a clear signal.

name: Table View
pageTitle: DSTV Installer Table View | Digitech DSTV
description: DSTV installation, repairs and signal fixing in Table View, facing Table Mountain across Table Bay.
intro: Table View is a beachside suburb on the northern shore of Table Bay, famous for its view of Table Mountain, its wide beaches and the kitesurfers at Bloubergstrand. We install and repair DSTV for the homes and apartments of Table View.
context: Strong summer wind off the bay is the main enemy of dishes here, and blown sand and salt wear down connectors quickly. We mount dishes for exposed conditions, align them carefully, and use weather-resistant connectors so the signal stays steady through the windy months.

faq.q: The south-easter seems to knock my signal out. What can I do?
faq.a: A firmer mounting and a careful alignment make a big difference. We can also check the cable and connectors, because wear on those often adds to the problem.

faq.q: Can you install in a Table View apartment with a sea view?
faq.a: Yes. We work with the building's rules and find a position with a clear line to the satellite, and we run cable cleanly so it does not affect the view.

name: Khayelitsha
description: DSTV installation, repairs and Extra View setup in Khayelitsha, with secure mounting and neat cabling for family homes.
intro: Khayelitsha is one of the largest and most densely populated areas on the Cape Flats, home to many families in a wide mix of housing. We install and repair DSTV for households and small businesses across Khayelitsha.
context: In busy family homes, several people often want to watch at once, so a second TV on the same subscription is a common request. Security matters too, so we mount dishes firmly and place them where they are secure and have a clear signal. We give you a clear quote first and explain what the installation involves.

faq.q: Can my family watch different channels in different rooms?
faq.a: Yes, with Extra View. A second decoder is linked to your subscription so another TV can watch its own channel. We install and set it up for you.

faq.q: How do I know what the installation will cost?
faq.a: We quote before any work begins, so you know the price up front. Contact us for a free quote and we will explain what is included.

name: Newlands
description: DSTV installation, repairs and signal fixing in Newlands, beside Newlands Forest and the stadiums.
intro: Newlands is a leafy Southern Suburbs neighbourhood below the mountain, beside Newlands Forest and best known for its rugby and cricket grounds. We install and repair DSTV for homes and flats across Newlands.
context: Trees are the main thing to plan around here, since big old gardens and the forest edge can shade a dish. Match days also mean a lot of people want a reliable signal at home. We choose a dish position with a clear line to the satellite and align it carefully, so big games do not come with a dropout.

faq.q: Can you make sure my DSTV is reliable for big matches?
faq.a: We can't control the broadcast, but we can make sure your dish, cabling and decoder are in good shape so the signal at your end is as strong as it can be.

faq.q: Will trimming a tree help my signal?
faq.a: Sometimes. We will tell you whether the tree is really the problem and whether moving the dish would solve it without cutting anything.

name: Diep River
pageTitle: DSTV Installer Diep River | Digitech DSTV
description: DSTV installation, repairs and signal fixing in Diep River, an established residential suburb in the Southern Suburbs.
intro: Diep River is an established residential suburb in the Southern Suburbs, close to Wynberg, Plumstead and Tokai, with long-standing family homes on quiet streets. We install and repair DSTV across Diep River.
context: Homes that have been lived in for decades often carry old dishes, patched cabling and decoders that have been moved around. We untangle what is there, replace what is worn out, and leave you with a clean setup, with extra TV points added if you need them.

faq.q: My DSTV cabling is very old. Should I replace it?
faq.a: If it is corroded, damaged or very old, yes. Poor cable is a frequent cause of dropouts, and replacing it is usually quicker and cheaper than chasing the fault.

faq.q: Can you move my DSTV to a different room?
faq.a: Yes. We can relocate the decoder and run the cable to the new spot, and check the signal there before we finish.

name: Kommetjie
description: DSTV installation, repairs and signal fixing in Kommetjie, the coastal village near Long Beach and Slangkop Lighthouse.
intro: Kommetjie is a small coastal village on the Atlantic side of the Cape Peninsula, known for Long Beach, its surf breaks and Slangkop Lighthouse. We provide DSTV installation, repairs and signal fixing for the homes of Kommetjie.
context: Right on the coast, wind and salt are a fact of life. They loosen dishes and corrode fixings faster than inland. Many houses here are holiday homes that sit empty between visits, so a fault can go unnoticed for weeks. We mount for exposed conditions and can check an unused home's setup before the next stay.

faq.q: My holiday home in Kommetjie has been empty for months. Can you check the DSTV?
faq.a: Yes. We test the dish, cabling and decoder, fix what has weathered, and get it ready for the next stay.

faq.q: Why does DSTV fail more often near the coast?
faq.a: Wind moves dishes and salt corrodes metal and connectors. Stronger mounting and weather-resistant parts reduce both problems.

name: Pinelands
description: DSTV installation, repairs and signal fixing in Pinelands, the garden suburb with heritage character.
intro: Pinelands is a planned garden suburb with tree-lined streets, Tudor-style cottages and a strong heritage character, close to Maitland and Thornton. We install and repair DSTV across Pinelands.
context: Parts of Pinelands are protected for their character, so where a dish can go on a street-facing wall or roof matters. Large mature trees can also shade it. We check what is allowed, pick a discreet position with a clear signal, and keep cabling out of sight.

faq.q: Are there rules about fitting a dish in Pinelands?
faq.a: Some areas have heritage or neighbourhood guidelines, particularly for what is visible from the street. We choose a discreet position and can advise on what you should check first.

faq.q: Can you hide the cable in an older cottage?
faq.a: Where we can, we use existing routes and gaps rather than cutting into walls, so the cable is out of sight and the building is not damaged.

name: Melkbosstrand
description: DSTV installation, repairs and signal fixing in Melkbosstrand, the coastal town on the West Coast road.
intro: Melkbosstrand is a coastal town on the West Coast road north of Table View, with a long beach, a mix of permanent residents and holiday homes, and the Koeberg power station nearby. We install and repair DSTV across Melkbosstrand.
context: It is open and exposed to the Atlantic wind, which pushes dishes out of alignment and wears connectors, and many homes are lived in only part of the year. We fix dishes firmly, re-align them with a meter, and replace weathered cabling so the signal holds up between visits.

faq.q: My signal has got worse over time. Why?
faq.a: Wind and weather slowly move a dish and wear the cable and connectors. A re-alignment and replacing worn parts usually brings it back.

faq.q: Can you install DSTV in a new home in Melkbosstrand?
faq.a: Yes. We fit the dish, run the cabling, set up the decoder, and add more rooms with Extra View if you want them.
